text: During the Gathering, Prancelaurel does her best to get on CougarClan's good side. (CougarClan relations improved.)
Mosi was found near RiverClan territory and driven far out of the surrounding lands.

The past moon, Flightsplash, Frondpad, and Odetta have taken their place in StarClan. c_n mourns their loss, and their Clanmates will miss where they had been in their lives. Moments of their lives are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to them take them to their final resting place.
